mapper.sql: d.id as id, d.batch_id as batchId, b.batch_no as batchNo, b.file_name as fileName, d.approval_id as approvalId, d.approval_no as approvalNo, d.approval_status as approvalStatus, d.row_num, d.parent_stand_name as parentStandName, d.segm_name as segmName, d.addr_level as addrLevel, d.segm_type as segmType, d.status as rowStatus, d.fail_reason as failReason, d.create_by as createBy, d.create_time as createTime
mapper.select:
select
from address_standard_import_fail_detail d left join address_standard_import_record b on b.id = d.batch_id and coalesce(b.del_flag, '0') = '0' where coalesce(d.del_flag, '0') = '0' and d.batch_id = #{batchId} and d.status in ('VALIDATE_FAILED', 'REJECTED_FAILED', 'EXECUTE_FAILED') order by d.row_num asc, d.id asc
select d.status as status, count(1) as count from address_standard_import_fail_detail d where coalesce(d.del_flag, '0') = '0' and d.batch_id = #{batchId} group by d.status
